market_definition: Global Empty Capsules Market: empty (unfilled) capsule shells used to make capsule dosage forms and supplements. By Capsule Type: Gelatin Capsules, Non-gelatin Capsules. By Material: Porcine, Bovine and Marine (Fish) Gelatin Capsules; Plant-based Capsules (HPMC, Pullulan, others such as Carrageenan); others (Polyvinyl Alcohol, etc.). By Functionality: Immediate-release, Delayed-release, Sustained-release, others (Targeted-release, etc.). By Shell Type: Hard, Soft. By Size: 000, 00, 0, 1, 2, others (3, 4, 5, etc.). By Purchase Mode: Online, Offline. By Application: Oral Release, Specialized Delivery, Pre-clinical and Clinical Solutions, others (Enteric, etc.). By End User: Biopharmaceutical Companies, Nutraceutical Companies, Clinical Research Organizations (CROs), others (Cosmetic Companies, etc.). Geography: global - North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Middle East, Africa. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - EMPTY CAPSULE DISTRIBUTOR: a company that buys empty capsules from capsule manufacturers (e.g. Lonza/Capsugel, ACG, Qualicaps, Suheung, CapsCanada, Sunil Healthcare) and resells them to pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, CRO and cosmetic manufacturers - pharmaceutical excipient distributors, capsule importers and stockists, and B2B (online or offline) capsule suppliers - manufacturing none of the capsules it sells. EXCLUDED companies: capsule manufacturers, contract manufacturers / CDMOs that fill capsules, capsule-filling machine sellers, finished supplement or drug brands, and pharmacies or shops selling only to consumers.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
